optimizedDescription.value: CompileContext assembles project+spec context for a change step; modes, deps traversal, GetSpecMetadata.

optimizedContext.value:
# CompileContext
## Rules
### Ports
- Inject: ChangeRepository, ListWorkspaces, SchemaProvider, FileReader, ArtifactParserRegistry, ContentHasher, PreviewSpec, GetSpecMetadata, baked `CompileContextConfig`.
- No LifecycleEngine/ImplementationDetector. No direct `readMetadataSnapshot`. Metadata via GetSpecMetadata (`if-needed`).
### Input
- `name`, `step` (entry point only — no readiness). Overrides: `contextMode`, `llmOptimizedContext`. `includeChangeSpecs` (default false), `followDeps` (default false), `depth`, `sections`, `fingerprint`. No per-call `config`.
### Effective config
- Shallow-merge baked defaults with runtime overrides for contextMode/llmOptimizedContext only.
### Guards / workspace qualifiers
- Schema name mismatch → SchemaMismatchError. Unknown workspace in patterns/dependsOn → warn+skip.
- Unqualified: project patterns→default; workspace patterns→that ws; dependsOn→declaring spec's ws.
### Spec collection
- Seed: `change.specIds` if includeChangeSpecs (mandatory vs excludes); always `change.specDependsOn` values.
- Then config five-step: project include → project exclude → active-ws include → active-ws exclude → dependsOn traversal iff followDeps. Traversal adds not subject to excludes. Deduplicate; first-match position.
### Display modes
- list / summary / full / hybrid (default summary). Hybrid: full only for includeChangeSpecs seeds; else summary. `sections` only full-mode metadata sections.
### dependsOn resolution
- Tier: change.specDependsOn → GetSpecMetadata → schema metadataExtraction.dependsOn. Cycles: break edge, no warn.
### Content materialization
- Summary/section full via GetSpecMetadata. Only materialize rendered specs. change.specIds + sections → merged PreviewSpec content. No sections → render scope:spec artifacts (spec.md first, then alpha). Preview fail → base fallback.
### Result
- `contextFingerprint`, `status` changed|unchanged, `projectContext`, `specs`, `warnings`. No lifecycle fields. Fingerprint match → empty arrays + unchanged.
### LLM optimized
- Prefer optimizedContext when enabled+nonempty. Bypass if sections omit both rules+constraints. Append scenarios if requested. stale-optimization warn: "Launch specd-spec-context-optimizer agent to refresh".
### Factory
- resolveCompileContextDeps → createCompileContext(deps). MUST NOT resolve LifecycleEngine.
## Constraints
- Project context first. Missing files/specs → warn+skip. Traversal opt-in. Max one entry per spec (priority: specIds>specDependsOn>dependsOnTraversal>includePattern).
- File access via SpecRepository/FileReader only. Instructions/hooks via GetArtifactInstruction/GetHookInstructions — not in result.
